verdict.rationale: Figma's REST/Variables API and Plugin API allow scripted create/update/delete across many objects (e.g., variables CRUD, library analytics summaries across all files), and community members describe using third-party 'bulk export' plugins to batch-process icons — showing bulk operations are achievable but not as a native, first-class AI-native bulk-action feature. Missing for 10: a documented first-party bulk-operation API/tool (e.g., a dedicated bulk-edit or bulk-export endpoint) and hands-on evidence that MCP/agent workflows can reliably perform large-scale batch edits without custom scripting or third-party plugins.
